definitions.SLO: completion-admission <= 1.5*(8*profile layer compute); numerical tolerance 1e-9 ms; full includes startup
definitions.coverage: AB compute coverage is reported separately from active admission/completion occupancy
definitions.demand: sum of each currently admitted request's exact per-disk bytes/C; extra next-request L0 demand not added; not actual SSD service
definitions.utilization: overlap of physical compute intervals/(32*window duration)

recomputation: Independent standard-library implementation; no producer/simulator/audit helper imports
